_readme: One-line adjudication notes for every disagreement listed by agreement.py. Written after unblinding by the re-coder (Claude Fable 5.1, subagent #162) from the transcript reading; 'lean X' records which code better fits the documented codebook, 'split' means both are defensible, 'label-level' means the same event coded under a different vocabulary word. The original data files are not changed. Systematic patterns: (1) confidence: original almost always 'high', re-coder usually 'medium' (calibration, not content); (2) role_in_plot: original used 'red_herring' for most cleared suspects, re-coder used initial_suspect/family_member/colleague (the codebook does not separate the two sharply); (3) accused_of: original defaulted to 'rape'/'csa' in SVU episodes where the person was suspected of a killing, re-coder used the specific offense; (4) original used exposure_channel values 'multiple' and 'legal' that are not in the documented vocabulary; (5) re-coder applied the partially_involved category literally (any in-plot wrongdoing) where the original coded proven_innocent; (6) re-coder omitted police-only clearances with no material harm, which the codebook (148 police_only rows in the corpus) includes.
